+def _build_httpx_mounts(proxies: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, httpx.HTTPTransport]:
+    """Build scheme-specific proxy mounts for httpx."""
+    mounts: dict[str, httpx.HTTPTransport] = {}
+    for scheme, proxy_url in proxies.items():
+        mount_scheme = scheme if scheme.endswith("://") else scheme + "://"
+        mounts[mount_scheme] = httpx.HTTPTransport(proxy=proxy_url)
+    return mounts
